description: This file defines a helper class, DataValidationHelper, within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for the Xls reader. It provides static methods and static mappings for data validation types, error styles, and operators used for processing Excel data validations.

classes.name: DataValidationHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for mapping data validation types, error styles, and operators to their string representations, used in handling Excel data validations within the PHPSpreadsheet Xls reader.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the data validation type string corresponding to the given integer code.

methods.name: errorStyle
methods.description: Returns the error style string corresponding to the given integer code.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator string corresponding to the given integer code.
